q2

pages.title: نظرة عامة على المرتجعات
pages.answer: نسبة المرتجعات من إجمالي الشحنات هي 11.3%. السبب الأكثر شيوعاً هو Changed mind بعدد 1,495، بينما الأقل شيوعاً هو Wrong address بعدد 1,380.

pages.answer: تتصدر محافظة Suez المرتجعات من حيث النسبة بـ 13.2%، بينما تتصدر القاهرة من حيث العدد بـ 1,890 مرتجعاً. بالنسبة لطرق الدفع، أعلى نسبة مرتجعات هي للنقد عند الاستلام بـ 15.3%.

pages.title: Revenue Overview
pages.answer: In 2025, total delivery fees were 4,371,304 EGP and COD amounts were 12,871,334 EGP. By service type, International had the highest revenue at 1,924,323 EGP, while Standard collected the most COD at 6,748,179 EGP. Monthly delivery fees and COD ranged from 297,851 EGP in January to 453,380 EGP in December.

pages.title: Performance Overview
pages.answer: The overall on-time delivery rate for same-day deliveries to Giza is 67.6%, with an average customer rating of 3.83. These figures cover a total of 2,641 deliveries.

pages.title: Delivery Overview
pages.answer: There are 62,662 total shipments. The typical delivery fee is 102.82 and the late delivery rate is 17.7%.

pages.title: Destination Breakdown
pages.answer: Cairo leads by count with 16,689 shipments, while Assiut has the lowest count at 1,694. By region, Greater Cairo leads with 34,234 shipments, and the Canal region has the lowest count at 4,944.
pages.note: This data has nothing called “drone deliveries”, so this page shows everything it holds.

pages.title: Delivery Performance
pages.answer: Upper Egypt has the highest late rate at 24.2%, while the Canal region has the lowest at 13.8%. Aswan has the highest typical delivery time at 4.40, and Gharbia has the lowest at 3.20.

pages.title: Delivery Outcomes
pages.answer: Out of 62,662 total shipments, 54,885 were Delivered and 277 were Lost. Same Day service has the highest late delivery rate at 31.53%, while Standard service has the lowest at 13.63%.
